subject: SOC II timing + procurement checklist — request for bridge window clarification
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@seabright.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: tom.lee@vendor-relays.com, procurement@seabright.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal evidence request: SOC II timing & procurement checklist

Hi Grace,

We're starting prep for Seabright's contract renewal (anniversary 2026-10-15) and procurement needs a few items to proceed with the renewal purchase order and legal redlines. Can you confirm the following: 

1) The latest SOC 2 Type II report you can provide (year/coverage).
2) Whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter that covers an audit gap if the new Type II report won't be issued before our renewal date. If yes, what dates would the bridge cover?
3) A quick procurement checklist with expected delivery dates for those artifacts so we can update our SOW and PO timeline.

I've attached our internal renewal checklist to show procurement gating items (Seabright_Renewal_Checklist.xlsx). Tom (cc'd) will help coordinate the security intake.

Thanks,
Sarah Jensen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Seabright Analytics

Attachment: Seabright_Renewal_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@seabright.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request: SOC II timing & procurement checklist

Hi Sarah — thanks for the checklist and the heads up. Quick answers and next steps below so procurement has a concrete timeline: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 (file: SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf).
- Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter scoped to the gap between the last covered period and the next attestation. Typical bridge coverage we offer is up to a 12-month interim window; we need to confirm exact dates with Marcus (security/compliance) and legal for wording.
- Proposed dates: Grace to confirm final deliverables by 2026-09-03 (SOC2 PDF and draft bridge). Marcus to share the bridge draft by 2026-08-31.

Can you confirm the audit period Seabright needs the bridge to cover (start/end)? If Seabright's renewal requires coverage through 2026-10-15 we may need the bridge to extend through at least 2026-10-15. Also, please confirm whether procurement needs an executed bridge letter (signed) before PO issuance or if a draft plus a signed attestation before go-live is acceptable.

I'll loop Marcus and Jordan for the formal draft and legal language touch points.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0126
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@seabright.com>, tom.lee@vendor-relays.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Draft bridge letter for Seabright - please review

Hi team,

Attached is a first-pass bridge letter draft that covers an interim window from 2025-10-01 through 2026-10-15. The draft is intentionally conservative on scope; legal will need to sign off on final phrasing. Key callouts: 

- The bridge references the SOC 2 Type II report for period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 (attached as SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf).
- We call out monitored controls and that no material changes affecting control effectiveness have occurred since the last report period (standard language).
- If Seabright requires signed confirmation before PO submission, we can provide an executed bridge letter within 3 business days of final sign-off.

Next actions I propose: 
1) Sarah: confirm acceptance of the proposed interim end date (2026-10-15) and whether Seabright needs signed docs pre-PO.
2) Grace/Jordan: route to legal for wording tweaks — I can adjust quickly once they flag specifics.

Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Draft.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PDF)

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@seabright.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, tom.lee@vendor-relays.com, procurement@seabright.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request: SOC II timing & procurement checklist

Hi Grace/Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- Seabright's procurement team requires coverage that includes our renewal effective date, 2026-10-15. Your proposed bridge end date (2026-10-15) works.
- We need the SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf file now to attach to our records (Marcus has attached it, thank you).
- Procurement policy: an executed bridge letter is required before the PO is issued. If Redwood can guarantee a signed bridge within 3 business days of final sign-off, that meets our gating rules.

Action items we need from Redwood:
1) Final bridge letter signed by an authorized Redwood signatory, delivered by 2026-09-06 EOD to procurement@seabright.com.
2) A brief statement (one paragraph) confirming there have been no material security control changes since 2025-09-30, suitable for inclusion in our purchase file.

If you can commit to that timing, we'll proceed with PO issuance and move legal forward. Tom, copying you to coordinate technical acceptance if needed.

Thanks,
Sarah Jensen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Seabright Analytics

Forwarded attachment references: Bridge_Letter_Draft.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf
